reason: README documents image-to-3D shape generation with a small public 0.6B Hunyuan3D-2mini turbo model that can run on CPU without any gated access.
demo: README 'Code Usage' (Hunyuan3DDiTFlowMatchingPipeline, image assets/demo.png -> mesh) using the Hunyuan3D-2mini turbo variant
goal: Install the project (CPU-only PyTorch, requirements.txt, pip install -e .; the texture/CUDA extensions are not needed) and run shape generation with Hunyuan3DDiTFlowMatchingPipeline.from_pretrained('tencent/Hunyuan3D-2mini', subfolder='hunyuan3d-dit-v2-mini-turbo', device='cpu', dtype=torch.float32) on assets/demo.png, calling pipeline.enable_flashvdm(). Export the resulting trimesh mesh to a .glb file. Importing hy3dgen.shapegen and loading the model weights from Hugging Face must work on CPU.
check: The hidden test runs the mini-turbo shape pipeline on CPU on assets/demo.png and verifies a valid non-degenerate exported GLB mesh.
